speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Disease (Neisseria gonorrhoeae).

I have identified the clinical signs of disseminated gonococcal infection, specifically the pustular rash with a sparing of the palms and soles, which correlates with your mother's history of gonorrhea. I will now request Gram stain and culture of the pustules to confirm the diagnosis.
